name: n8n-prod
description: Production n8n for workflows and credentials that should not sit on an instance where workflows are authored freely. Isolated stack, own Postgres, own tunnel.

managed_update.note: Builds nothing. Adopts an image already built and verified for the authoring instance, pinned in this service's .env. An update is a re-pin plus a recreate.

promotion.note: Repository and token are site-specific and come from the service .env: PROMOTION_REPOSITORY, PROMOTION_TOKEN. Give the token read access only; the branch protection is the control, not the token.
